source_note: The application source and candidate APK are committed together. Promotion copies identical validated bytes.
resolution_note: Requested sizes are not guarantees. Actual received, preview and saved dimensions plus analysis FPS are displayed. Preview is reduced before analysis when a stream combination fails.
image_note: Full same-frame YUV420 camera output retained with chroma, converted directly to rotated RGB, and saved as lossless color PNG. No JPEG intermediate or bitmap enlargement. Legacy grayscale records remain grayscale.
coordinate_space: Candidates and clipped analysis ROI reprojected from the shared analysis crop onto the full saved display frame, before annotation footer.
